notes: Day-0 tensor-name map for the minicpm5 family (bring-up kit W1.2). SHAPES VERIFIED against the single shard's safetensors header read by HTTP range request at revision cd199ce3 on 2026-09-10; the index's weight_map key set equals the header's key set (381 tensors). The repacker does not read this file; ArchInfo.loadMiniCPM5 and the generic planners carry the same contract in code.

{L} = 0..41. Every layer is full attention (fullAttentionLayerMask all 1): no sliding window, no linear attention, no MoE, no router, no shared expert. The tensor names are the plain HF LlamaForCausalLM layout: bare `model.` trunk prefix and a top-level `lm_head.weight`, the same spelling the runtime already uses for deepseekV4Flash and maple, so both the pre-quantized path (control) and the quantize-in-flight path (this family) write the names the runner looks up without renaming.

Norms: transformers v5.6.2 modeling_llama.py LlamaRMSNorm.forward computes `weight * (x * rsqrt(mean(x^2) + eps))` with the reduction in fp32 and the weight multiply in the input dtype. There is NO (1 + w) fold (contrast Qwen 3.6 / Flash-Next). FlashNextPlanner.foldsNormBias must return false for this family; all 85 norm vectors ride through as BF16 passthrough.

RoPE: LlamaRotaryEmbedding.compute_default_rope_parameters uses dim = head_dim (128) and inv_freq = 1 / theta^(arange(0, dim, 2)/dim) with theta 5e6, applied via rotate_half (NeoX half rotation over the full head). In ArchConfig terms: ropeNeoxSubdim true, partialRotaryFactor 1.0 (rotaryDim == headDim == 128), ropeTheta == fullRopeTheta == 5000000.0, rope_scaling null.

Attention: scaling = head_dim ** -0.5 = 0.08838834764831845; attention_bias false and mlp_bias false (config defaults; no bias tensors are present in the header); NO q_norm / k_norm tensors exist -> the new `qkNorm` axis is false for this family; no attention output gate (q_proj is [2048, 2048] = numHeads * headDim rows, not 2x).

Vocabulary: vocab_size 130560 == embedding rows == lm_head rows; tokenizer.json holds 130072 BPE ids (0..130071) plus added tokens up to id 130559, so unpaddedVocabSize stays 0 (every row is addressable). tie_word_embeddings false: lm_head.weight is its own 534,773,760-byte tensor.

Quantization policy (matches the vendor MLX control exactly): every rank-2 BF16 .weight whose last dim is a multiple of 64 -> INT4 affine group-64 (embed_tokens, lm_head, q/k/v/o, gate/up/down); norms BF16 passthrough. The control's model.safetensors.index.json declares total_size 1,415,925,760, which is exactly (2,516,756,480 - 174,080 norm params) * 0.5625 + 174,080 * 2 = 1,415,577,600 + 348,160 -- the same byte count this plan produces, so the two installs carry byte-comparable resident sets.

The MLX control is the first pre-quantized control whose repo is the vendor's own (openbmb), not mlx-community. Its config carries the same `quantization {group_size 64, bits 4, mode affine}` block as the pinned qwen36 source, no per-tensor overrides, and packs U32 [rows, cols/8] weights with BF16 [rows, cols/64] scales and biases -- the repacker's generic pre-quantized path (IndexLoader + RepackPlanner) needs only the family case, not a new planner.

Sidecars: none. There is no vision tower, no MTP group, no PLE table in either repo. The vendor's DSpark drafter (openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B-DSpark) is a separate repo and out of scope for this bring-up (see the family page's follow-on note).
